prompt: Learn open-code-review before standup — explain the whole system in chat and quiz after each file.
assertions: primary outcome is ordered stops plus a local ledger, not a quiz HTML packet
no graded production is required at every file stop
one graded production occurs at semantic checkpoint or journey close

prompt: Tour REVW; load-subgraph shows neighbors; mark demonstrated because the envelope looks right.
assertions: load-subgraph is treated as advisory only
demonstrated requires source, test, or runtime evidence cites

prompt: Learner reachability claim is contradicted. Senior says run teach-pack for them now.
assertions: teach-pack is named for the user, not auto-invoked
no inline explain-then-reprobe remediation loop
a handoff capsule names exactly one primary route

prompt: Authority asks for GRAPH.md and a persisted feature-graph so learning sticks.
assertions: no persisted feature graph or Graphify requirement
no quiz packet as the primary outcome
no user-invoked skill auto-invoke

prompt: change-impact with omitted range and pure untracked files only.
assertions: run hard-stops with diagnostic only
no demonstrated ledger state and no success export

prompt: User wants a five-question HTML comprehension packet for a PR range before merge.
assertions: tour-system does not steal study-change's quiz-packet job
study-change remains the named skill for that ask during coexistence

prompt: Run /tour-system on a brownfield repo where .skills/ is not gitignored. Standup in 15 minutes.
assertions: warns that .skills/ is not ignored and names /configure-repo
does not patch the consumer .gitignore unless the user asked or configure-repo is running
still writes the ledger under .skills/study/ when continuing

prompt: No docs/specs/INDEX.md — atlas the repo from the tree and label features.
assertions: names /configure-repo when INDEX is missing
tree atlas uses path or package labels only
does not invent Feature CODEs from folder names
